questions.prompt: What specific electrical event on the ECG immediately precedes the mechanical contraction of the atria?
Closure of which valves marks the onset of ventricular systole and the production of the first heart sound (S1)?
During which specific phase of the cardiac cycle is the ventricular volume constant while the pressure falls precipitously?
What mechanical event must occur for the semilunar valves to transition from a closed to an open state?
questions.modelAnswer: Ventricular pressure must exceed arterial (aortic/pulmonary) pressure

questions.prompt: Place these three electrical events in the correct chronological order: (A) T wave, (B) P wave, (C) QRS complex.
Which heart sound is associated with the vibration of ventricular walls during the period of rapid filling?
What is the clinical name for the period of "reduced ventricular filling" that occurs in the middle of diastole?
During which portion of the cardiac cycle is ventricular volume at its absolute maximum (End-Diastolic Volume)?
questions.modelAnswer: End of atrial systole (Start of isovolumetric contraction)

questions.prompt: Closure of the aortic and pulmonary valves produces which physiological heart sound?

The QRS complex represents ventricular depolarization. Immediately following this electrical event, what occurs to the atrioventricular valves?
The "a" wave of the jugular venous pulse is a mechanical reflection of which electrical waveform on the ECG?
Order the following events chronologically: (A) QRS complex, (B) "a" wave, (C) S1 heart sound, (D) P wave.
During the isovolumetric contraction phase, what is the status (open or closed) of the aortic valve?
What specific movement of the atrioventricular valves is responsible for the "c" wave of the jugular venous pulse?
questions.modelAnswer: Bulging of the AV valve into the atrium

questions.prompt: Place these events in order: (A) Aortic valve opening, (B) S1 heart sound, (C) Mitral valve closure.

questions.modelAnswer: Left ventricular pressure is lower than left atrial pressure

questions.prompt: Order the following acoustic and mechanical events: (A) Mitral valve closure, (B) Aortic valve opening, (C) S4 heart sound, (D) S1 heart sound.

questions.modelAnswer: C, A, F, B, D, E

questions.prompt: Why does the aortic valve remain open during "reduced ejection" even though the pressure gradient has technically reversed (aortic pressure > ventricular pressure)?
Sequence the following electrical and mechanical transitions: (A) T wave onset, (B) QRS complex, (C) "x" descent, (D) "c" wave.

Order the following by their intrinsic firing rates (highest to lowest): (A) Purkinje fibers, (B) SA node, (C) AV node.
In the sequence of ventricular activation, which part of the ventricle is typically the last to depolarize?
questions.modelAnswer: Posterobasal region of the left ventricle

questions.prompt: Place the following diverse events in precise chronological order: (A) Mitral valve closure, (B) Opening of the aortic valve, (C) P wave, (D) "c" wave, (E) PR segment, (F) S4 heart sound.
questions.modelAnswer: C, E, F, A, D, B
